prompt_en: Create a photographic autumn fashion editorial of a fictional adult woman wearing layered autumn clothing, with her face and hair guided by the supplied reference. Preserve its oval facial outline, dark gray-brown eyes, softly shaped nose and full muted rose lips; her short black bob curves inward around the jaw beneath separated wispy bangs. She is an invented observatory assistant caught halfway through carrying a loose sky chart indoors after a shower. On the flagstone terrace of a small hilltop observatory, an open instrument-room doorway glows behind her; a telescope barrel is softly visible inside. A waist-high stone ledge beside her is dark with water beads, so the loose paper must stay above it. A gust has curled the chart's exposed upper corner toward that wet ledge. Her left forearm supports the bottom of a stiff dark-blue document portfolio at her left hip, and her left fingers curl around its lower outer edge. The portfolio is held upright with its front cover slightly open toward the camera: the chart's lower half rests flat inside, while its upper half protrudes above the cover with a few dark star dots joined by fine lines. Her right elbow bends comfortably across her lower chest; her right thumb and index finger pinch the free upper corner and lift its curled tip clear of the ledge. The lower half is already sheltered inside the portfolio, while the lifted corner stays visibly dry above the beaded stone. Both hands and their separate contacts are visible. The pinched corner rests firmly between her fingertips while a clear air gap separates the paper from wet stone. She looks directly at the lifted paper corner, brows gently drawn in concentration and lips softly parted as the immediate problem begins to ease. A slight lift of her bob and shell jacket hem carries the same breeze through the frame. Her olive windbreaker shell hangs open at the hips, its separated zipper tracks making a broad opening. The parted olive shell fronts frame the cream fleece collar rising around her throat, with the fleece pile visibly behind the shell's neckline on the same torso. The shell has a smooth matte surface broken by broad fold highlights; the cream inner fleece has dense soft pile, and its small cuffs emerge from the olive sleeve openings. Fine corduroy ribs on the russet skirt remain separate from the fleece pile and the windbreaker's broad crease highlights. Below the short shell, a russet A-line midi skirt shows distinct narrow vertical corduroy wales and a relaxed fold responding to her turn. Chestnut leather lace-up ankle boots have neatly tied laces, gentle ankle flex creases and solid soles on the damp flagstones. Both boot soles rest on the level terrace, her weight settled over her left leg and her right toe turned toward the doorway. The portfolio stays beside her left hip, leaving the shell opening and most of the skirt readable. Use a vertical full-body frame with a small margin above her hair and both complete boots visible, from a slight front three-quarter position near chest height. Keep the lifted paper, her face and the garment layers clear at the same time, with the doorway and ledge still recognizable behind and beside her. Her face remains readable above the portfolio within this crop. The action-bearing right hand and its pinch contact stay distinct from the paper edge. The telescope barrel inside the doorway serves as a clear place cue for the observatory setting. Let more distant hills soften while these three connected planes remain legible. Soft cool late-afternoon daylight reveals the smooth shell folds, fleece pile and corduroy ribs. The doorway's warm light grazes her near cheek and the adjacent portfolio rim, while cool sky light continues across the olive sleeves and wet ledge. A few copper leaves adhere to the damp stone near the threshold. The scene feels attentively observed and quietly appealing, with the delicate paper rescue as the living moment inside a tactile, believable autumn outfit.
